description: This file contains internal utility functions related to session key management in the app, including normalization, validation, resolution of agent IDs, and construction of session keys.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Normalizes the input string to a main session key, defaulting to 'main' if input is null or empty.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if the provided session key string is considered canonical, e.g., 'global' or starting with 'agent:'.

methods.name: resolveAgentIdFromMainSessionKey
methods.description: Extracts the agent ID from the session key if it starts with 'agent:'.

methods.name: buildNodeMainSessionKey
methods.description: Builds a session key string for a node, incorporating device ID and optional agent ID.
